title: Stand inside the care already holding you
summary: Fear wavers because it forgets who made and sustains the life it is trying to protect. The Creator who formed you is named here as the One who will also give support.
takeaway: Let the Creator's protection answer the first tremor.
lifeApplication: When the mind starts outrunning the day, pause at the doorway, screen, or sink. Before planning again, tell the fear what the shabad says: the One who created you is not absent from your need.

source.shortMeaning: The Creator who made the mortal is also the One who protects and gives support.
source.lifeApplication: When fear grips the body, answer it with the Creator's promised care before you plan from panic.

evidence.coreClaim: The Creator who made the mortal is also the One who protects and gives support.
evidence.turn: Let the Creator's protection answer the first tremor before fear writes its own future.
